news.headline: Kalshi, Polymarket trading volumes on some products raise questions amid massive growth
news.summary: Prediction market platforms Kalshi and Polymarket are facing questions about trading authenticity as unusual volume patterns emerge amid explosive growth. Experts are scrutinizing whether reported trading figures represent genuine market activity or something less organic.

news.headline: Accenture rallies more than 20% after earnings beat, heads for best day ever
news.summary: Accenture stock jumped on stronger-than-expected fiscal Q4 earnings, marking its best day on record. The consulting giant's beat sent shares rallying as investors rewarded the solid performance.

educational.title: What Is Bitcoin's 'Halving' and Why Does It Matter?
points: Roughly every 4 years, Bitcoin's mining reward is cut in half by design
This slows how fast new bitcoin enters circulation, capping supply growth
It's baked into the code — no company or person decides when it happens
Historically, halvings have preceded major price cycles, though it's not guaranteed
The last coin will ever be mined around the year 2140 due to this schedule
